fate.yuanxian.sword_obsession.descriptio: Sword melee hits build momentum; a finishing hit at full stacks launches a sword wave. Timeout or weapon swap clears the streak; derived waves never build stacks or trigger further procs.
fate.yuanxian.pill_aegis.description: Vitality Pills heal more and grant a separate temporary shield after successful use. Shields do not stack. Medicine cooldown and damage-interrupted healing still apply.
fate.yuanxian.tempered_bones.description: Health lost to direct enemy attacks builds resolve. At full resolve, the next melee hit adds weapon damage and knocks nearby enemies away. Environmental, self, allied and bonus damage grant no resolve; sword qi cannot spend it.
fate.yuanxian.open_meridians.description: Greater qi capacity. A paid active skill refunds part of its actual cost on a successful hit, once per cast. Free and derived attacks grant no refund.
fate.yuanxian.fire_spirit_body.descripti: Direct health damage applies attributed burning; repeated hits on the same target trigger a burst. Burning and bursts never build stacks or trigger more procs.
fate.yuanxian.wood_spirit_body.descripti: 直接攻击敌人的实际生命损失可转为回复，每秒回复有上限；获得主动能力「缠根」，可在 H 技能页分配键位。缠根消耗灵力，使附近可见敌人暂时定身，强敌受控时间缩短。
fate.yuanxian.metal_spirit_body.descript: Increases innate health, body defense and knockback resistance. Actual enemy hits build temporary category-specific defense adaptation.
fate.yuanxian.innate_sword_heart.descrip: Perfectly dodge a direct enemy attack to gain an opening: the next accepted sword hit critically strikes and launches a piercing wave. A real shield contact also consumes it.
fate.yuanxian.phoenix_body.description: Increases innate health, fire damage and healing received. Fire seed supports healing and a vulnerable ember phase before rebirth.
fate.yuanxian.everlasting_embryo.descrip: Maximum lifespan +50%. From Qi Refining onward, natural online aging grants permanent health, body defense and personal attack in 0.5-point increments. Growth depends on the current major realm; earned attributes and partial progress persist through death and logout.

exploration.yuanxian.guide.awaken: Use a Spirit Testing Stele to awaken your spiritual root.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.initiate: Receive Basic Breathing at a Technique Inheritance Stele.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.qi_explore: Reach Qi Refining 4 and obtain iron. Explore nearby mines and gather forging materials.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.qi_late: Reach Qi Refining 7; try normal trials and prepare medicines.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.foundation: Consolidate stability and advance to early Foundation before a sustained Nether expedition.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.nether: Prepare fire resistance, gold gear and return coordinates, then enter the Nether.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.fortress: Bring fire resistance and supplies, then find a Nether fortress and obtain a blaze rod.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.stronghold: Craft eyes of ender and locate a stronghold. Prepare a safe return route.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.golden: Reach Golden Core and gather supplies for your first End expedition.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.dragon: Prepare for the dragon: destroy its crystals before fighting the body, then explore the outer islands through a gateway.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.awakening: The Spirit Testing Stele opens awakening; it does not teach a core technique.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.safety: Set a bed, carry food and light your shelter before long trips.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.breathing: Basic Breathing lets you begin the cultivation loop.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.meditation: Use the cultivation panel to accumulate progress, then consolidate stability.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.mining: Deep caves supply dark iron; riverbanks supply edge-tempering sand.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.forging: Use a pattern book to learn it permanently, then forge at a ding.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.trial: Normal trials are advised at Qi Refining 7–9; ominous trials at middle–late Foundation.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.alchemy: Learn a formula once; herbs from exploration can be planted and harvested.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.stability: Full cultivation progress alone is not enough; stability must also meet the advancement requirement.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.nether: Portals are unrestricted by default; server owners can opt into realm gates. Fire resistance still matters.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.fire: Realm health does not grant lava or fire immunity.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.gold: Gold equipment helps with ordinary piglins; do not rely on it against brutes.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.fortress: Block wither skeleton approaches and establish cover before fighting blazes.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.conversion: Craft one spirit copper ingot from a copper ingot, blaze powder and a low-grade spirit stone. Qi infusion remains an alternative.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.eyes: Eyes of ender combine ender pearls and blaze powder; keep extras for the portal.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.return: Write down your portal coordinates and protect the route.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.golden: Golden Core is the proposed End stage; improve gear and arts alongside realm.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.end: Void falls remain lethal regardless of realm.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.void: Bring blocks and an escape plan for levitation and void edges.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.overworld: Establish shelter, food and tools. Local monsters follow the regional realm.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.caves: Bring light, a shield and a retreat route; deep caves contain dark iron.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.lush_caves: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.dripstone_c: Watch ledges and dripstone. Realm does not remove fall damage.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.ocean: Prepare air, visibility and a way back. Health cannot replace oxygen.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.village: Trade and resupply. Protect villagers and avoid an unprepared raid.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.ruined_port: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.buried_trea: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.trail_ruins: Bring a brush and avoid breaking suspicious blocks.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.igloo: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.shipwreck: Check your air and exit before searching the hold.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.ocean_ruins: Prepare air and watch drowned; their tridents scale with their realm.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.desert_pyra: Inspect pressure plates and TNT. Realm advice does not make traps safe.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.jungle_temp: Look for tripwires and dispensers before opening chests.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.swamp_hut: Prepare for potion effects rather than relying only on health.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.mineshaft: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.dungeon: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.outpost: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.mansion: Prepare for evokers, vexes and axe attacks; avoid pulling several rooms.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.stronghold: Bring eyes of ender and leave yourself a way out near the End portal room.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.trial: Complete a normal trial first. An ominous bottle deliberately raises the challenge.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.ominous_tri: Ominous spawners use a separate realm band. Bring supplies and an exit.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.raid: Protect villagers. Raiders retain their birth realm when moved.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.monument: Bring water breathing, night vision, milk and an underwater exit. Elder guardians are optional; use /exploration guide side.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.deep_dark: Avoid repeated shrieker activations. Sneaking, wool and an exit are safer than a direct fight.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.ancient_cit: Sneak, use wool and keep an escape route. Killing a warden is not required for exploration or the main route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.nether: Bring fire resistance and gold gear, and note the coordinates of your return portal.
exploration.yuanxian.location.nether_haz: Soul sand valley and basalt deltas
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.nether_haza: Watch ranged attacks, slowing ground and lava drops; establish a safe route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.nether_land: Bring light and keep a retreat route.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.fortress: Bring fire resistance and watch wither skeletons. Blaze powder, copper and spirit stone craft spirit copper.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.bastion: Piglin brutes are dangerous. Prepare for late Foundation in treasure areas; stealth remains useful.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.end: Ordinary island endermen use an independent End band. Bring ranged tools, supplies and safe footing before destroying crystals; the void remains lethal.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.end_city: Plan cover, safe landings and protection against levitation and falls. End ships retain their elytra value.
message.yuanxian.life.reason.guide_servi: Helping travelers at the inn reception.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.islands: Use an End gateway to reach the outer islands; bring blocks, pearls and a safe return plan.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.end_city: Find an End city, deal with shulkers carefully and secure your footing before looting.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.elytra: Find a city with an End ship, retrieve an elytra, and prepare fireworks and repairs.
exploration.yuanxian.guide.side_hint: [Optional branches: elder guardian / wither / warden] Click for advice and preparation; these do not block the main route.
exploration.yuanxian.portal.denied: Native portal realm gates are enabled here. You need at least %s; returning to the Overworld remains unrestricted.
exploration.yuanxian.prepare.end_outer: Bring pearls, blocks and return coordinates. Outer-island mobs do not inherit Overworld region bands; avoid staring at endermen.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.dragon: Crystals heal the dragon. Deal with crystals and cages first; perched and flying phases have different hit conditions.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.flying_sword: A flying sword helps with controlled ascent and viewing crystals. Existing combat moves are unavailable while mounted; plan crystal removal and ground attacks separately.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.islands: Enter gateways with pearls or a suitable approach. Record landing and return points, and keep spare pearls.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.shulkers: Shulkers cause levitation. Bring slow falling, pearls and cover; secure your landing before engaging elevated targets.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.storage: Shells and a chest make a shulker box. Portable storage and finite city chests reward exploration; opened chests do not refill.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.elytra: Only cities with an End ship offer an elytra. Clear nearby shulkers before taking it and keep return supplies.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.flight: Elytra offer unmounted long-distance gliding and firework boosts. Prepare durability, rockets and landing sites; controlled sword ascent serves a different purpose.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.elder: Monuments are optional. Clear guardians and open a retreat before handling elder beams and thorns; avoid being surrounded underwater.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.underwater: Water breathing and night vision help underwater. Milk removes mining fatigue and your other potion effects, so prepare another breathing potion.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.wither: Before summoning, clear important buildings and allies from the area. Bring sustained healing, ranged and close attacks, and supplies against the wither effect.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.wither_arena: The summoning blast precedes the fight; attack eligibility changes at low health. Use a separate arena with an exit, away from towns.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.warden: A direct warden fight is optional and never blocks the guide route. Sneak for loot, use wool to control sound and retreat promptly.
exploration.yuanxian.tip.stealth: Warden sonic attacks pass through walls. Armor does not replace distance and an escape plan; a cramped shelter is not a safe zone.

exploration.yuanxian.tiger.title: Thunderhorn Tiger · %s: prepare armour, healing and a movement technique.
exploration.yuanxian.tiger.where: Seek an open rocky valley in Overworld mountains or meadows. Entering its lair awakens the tiger; existing worlds need new chunks.
exploration.yuanxian.tiger.combat: A raised shoulder warns of claws; a crouch warns of a pounce. Leave glowing thunder marks, then punish the recovery.
exploration.yuanxian.tiger.horn: Lure a pounce into the lair pillars, then strike the lowered head. Body hits cannot break the horn; breaking it suppresses lightning.
exploration.yuanxian.tiger.phase: When badly wounded, the tiger enrages and leaves delayed lightning after its pounce. Watch the marks before closing in.
exploration.yuanxian.tiger.retreat: You may retreat and return. Normal saves preserve wounds and the broken horn; a cleared lair will not respawn its tiger.
